verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public API in depth. Credentials are issued with configurable permissions and expiry, and there are reference endpoints for customers, monitoring, cases, audit, exports and transactions. Rate limiting, versioning, a Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI schema are also documented, and a probe retrieved and parsed the OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec. The docs state that cases and alerts can be fully remediated via the API instead of the web app. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of authenticated API operations (the probe only retrieved documentation).
